name: Laramie County, WY
findings: Laramie County has 490 nonprofit organizations. 207 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 163 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Laramie County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Professional organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 19 professional organizations here list membership, compared with about 7 in similar places of this size.
